threads.body: [General] The reusable-workflow reference starts with `$/`, but GitHub Actions requires `./.github/workflows/<file>` for a local workflow (or an `owner/repo/...@ref` reference). This makes the caller invalid, so neither branch's SDK update nor the failure-notification job can run. Use `./` here.

replies.body: `$/` is supported for reusable workflow calls on github.com. GitHub introduced this syntax in July 2026 and recommends it for same-repository references: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-30-reference-same-repository-actions-with-self-repository-syntax/. It resolves the workflow from the same repository at the exact running commit. This change addresses zizmor's `self-repository` finding, so reverting to `./` would restore that finding. Keeping the current reference.
